certification.name: SABSA Chartered Security Architect, Practitioner Certificate
certification.description: Practitioner level of SABSA, earned by SCF holders who attend one Advanced course (A1 to A5) and pass its exam module. The exam is a written assignment answering two of five questions within four weeks, dual-marked with a 75% pass mark.
certification.currency_note: Fee set by accredited education partners; candidates must attend an official SABSA Advanced course
